note: A declared case counts as a corruption offence for dashboard purposes ONLY when a qualifying rule below matches. PMLA, cheating, breach of trust, and unmapped provisions are never auto-classified — they go to needs_review. Ordinary offences under other statutes are 'no'.

qualifying.citation: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 (predecessor statute, mapped and documented in docs/methodology.md)

explicitlyNotAuto.reason: Money-laundering is not a corruption offence for this dashboard's definition; individual review required before any classification.
Cheating offences are not auto-classified as corruption.
Criminal breach of trust (including by public servant) is not auto-classified as corruption.
Electoral bribery under IPC Chapter IXA requires individual review before classification.
BNS successor provisions to cheating/breach of trust are not auto-classified as corruption.
